title: cymbalaria pallida
intro: Cymbalaria pallida, commonly known as the alpine marsh treacle or  ivy-leaved toadflax, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbalaria pallida include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
